description: One reading published by a node to beehive/<id_nodo>/data. Generated from mqtt_handler/contract.py in meshbee-server; the code that consumes it is mqtt_handler/payload.py. Every field is optional and unknown fields are preserved, so adding one is a backwards-compatible change. No field carries a payload version yet; see the contract docs for the planned versioning scheme.

bat.description: Node battery voltage in V. Out of range drops the whole message.

dati_raw.description: Anything else the firmware wants to keep — RSSI and so on. Stored verbatim as JSONB.

id_nodo.description: Node identifier. Optional in the body: it falls back to the <id_nodo> segment of the topic, and the body wins when both are present. A message is rejected only when neither supplies one.

id_sensore.description: Identifies the hive on that node. An unknown value provisions a new hive; when absent, the node's first hive is used.

peso.description: Hive weight in kg. Out of range drops the whole message.

temperatura.description: Temperature in °C. Out of range drops the whole message.

timestamp.description: Reading time, ISO 8601. A trailing Z is accepted. Absent or unparseable values fall back to server time.

umidita.description: Relative humidity in %. Out of range drops the whole message.

title: MeshBee MQTT payload
